verdict.rationale: Sentry's Trace Explorer documents flexible queries, filters and aggregation over span attributes. The Issues page supports filtering by properties such as impacted users. Nothing in the evidence says this works for high-cardinality fields like user id or request id, or that no pre-aggregation or index definition is needed. missing for 10: explicit high-cardinality group-by/filter support, documentation that no pre-aggregation or index setup is required, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group and filter by high-cardinality fields (user id, request id) without pre-aggregating or defining indexes first

citations.quote: You can now explore span samples, visualize span attributes, and aggregate your data with flexible queries and filters.
This page allows you to filter by properties such as browser, device, impacted users, or whether an error is unhandled.
